title: Building SOLVE
objective: Build an AI-native environment where any person can create, modify, save, reopen and publish a genuinely functioning World; use SOLVE-provided default AI within limits while user-owned external AI connections remain optional; coordinate development through source-backed Missions and portable handoffs.

decisions.value: Option B: verify and retain trusted kernel/persistence/authority; selectively rebuild application UI and product layer
main is canonical; fresh branches/PRs; no reset, blanket merge or feature-branch-as-trunk
SOLVE-native AI from onboarding using a controlled hosted default; personal third-party provider connection optional; native editing works without inference
SOV ID based on independent sovereign-passport, integration to be verified
portable source-backed context packages, explicit task ownership and verified outcomes; no claim of live access to private agent sessions

evidence.caveat: Claude-reported staging SQL/test observations were not independently rerun here.

evidence.reason: Requires personal connected AI for basic work.
Defines proposed quality gates, not passed deployment gates.

evidence.caveat: Preview SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY mismatch suspected; not independently reverified here.

blockers.description: Verify Preview server key/project match; authorized and unauthorized World-read paths; never log secret.
Review main and divergent branches in narrow, reversible PRs.
Confirm accessible repository or deployment and interface before editing SOV Passport.
Confirm supported provider, funding model and hard spending caps before promising included hosted AI in production.

work_items.title: Map and reproduce native World create/edit/save/reopen + AI entry path on main
AI intention -> validated native World objects -> preview/edit/save/reopen with model-independent fallback
Publish public page/form -> nonmember response -> private record/task
Verify staging key and bot-versus-user read authority without security bypass
Map divergent branches and PRs into main-based reviewable slices
Use MD+JSON for explicit Claude/ChatGPT/Muse handoffs, then wire to real World

next_action: On a fresh main-based branch, reproduce the actual native World path and identify the minimum change needed for default AI-assisted intention-to-World composition; do not merge or deploy.

rules: No secrets or unrelated private data
No invented live AI session control
No production deploy or destructive migrations without consent
Verification must be attributable and linked

release_acceptance: User obtains useful AI-assisted World without supplying a personal AI key
User edits native objects and reopens persistent state without model availability
Public output works for nonmembers; authorized submission returns as private work
Second person with limited permissions can contribute but cannot access unrelated data
Second AI can continue a bounded task from mission context with source-backed output
